title: Siege of Cusco
summary: Wikidata item Q2398589, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1536–1537 siege in South America". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.

actors.note: Wikidata names the Inca Empire (Q28573) a participant of the siege; this atlas already holds that polity.
